title: Observability — Pipeline health
description: Is the observability stack collecting, storing and alerting? Scrape targets, ingestion of metrics, logs and spans, dropped data, disk and retention per store, rule evaluation and notifications, DNS, and the stack's own restarts and memory, each linking to the component's dashboard.

list.name: Node restarts
list.expr: (max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) > max_over_time((max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)))[30m:1m] offset 1m)) * on (node) group_left (label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) max by (node, label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) (kube_node_labels)
list.textFormat: Pool {{label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool}} ({{label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning}}): spot preemption, upgrade or repair; its pods were rescheduled

list.name: Container restarts
list.expr: (changes(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="monitoring"}[1m]) > 0) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left (reason) max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="monitoring"})

panels.title: Scrape targets down
panels.description: Targets vmagent cannot scrape right now (TargetDown alerts when more than 10% of a job is down).

panels.title: Metric samples / s
panels.description: Samples VMSingle receives (both vmagent replicas; it deduplicates them at 30s).

panels.title: Log lines / s
panels.description: Log lines and Kubernetes events VLSingle stores. 0 fires LogsIngestionStopped.

panels.title: Spans / s
panels.description: Spans VTSingle receives from the services over OTLP. 0 while the shop serves requests fires TracesIngestionStopped.

panels.title: Records dropped
panels.description: Metric samples, log lines and spans the pipeline threw away in the time range; the Dropped data row says where and why.

targets.expr: sum (label_replace(round(sum by (reason) (increase(vm_rows_ignored_total{job="vmsingle-vmks"}[$__range]))), "cause", "Metrics rejected by VMSingle: $1", "reason", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum(increase({__name__=~"vm(agent)?_(hourly|daily)_series_limit_rows_dropped_total"}[$__range]))), "cause", "Metrics over the series limit", "", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum(increase(vmagent_remotewrite_samples_dropped_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Metric samples dropped by vmagent", "", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum(increase(vmagent_remotewrite_packets_dropped_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Metric blocks rejected by VMSingle", "", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum by (job) (increase(vl_too_long_lines_skipped_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Log lines too long ($1)", "job", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum by (reason) (increase(vl_rows_dropped_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Log lines rejected: $1", "reason", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum(increase(vlagent_remotewrite_packets_dropped_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Log blocks rejected by VLSingle", "", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum by (reason) (increase(vt_rows_dropped_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Spans rejected: $1", "reason", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum(increase(vmalert_remotewrite_dropped_rows_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Recording rule results dropped by vmalert", "", "(.*)")) or vector(0)

panels.title: Rule evaluation errors
panels.description: Rule evaluations that failed in the time range (per vmalert replica; both evaluate every rule). Failing rules cannot fire.

panels.title: Notifications failed
panels.description: Alerts vmalert could not hand to Alertmanager, plus notifications Alertmanager could not deliver (Slack).

panels.title: Days until a store's limit
panels.description: Fewest days, among VMSingle, VLSingle and VTSingle, until the disk reaches its limit at the last day's growth (the Storage row has each store).

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Every target whose last scrape failed. Empty is healthy.

panels.title: Targets down and failed scrapes
panels.description: Down targets per job (left) and failed scrapes across both vmagent replicas (right).

panels.title: Samples per scrape, top 10 jobs
panels.description: Series each job adds per scrape: where the cardinality comes from.

panels.title: Metrics into VMSingle
panels.description: Samples per second by protocol (left) and new series per second (right: churn, e.g. after rollouts).

panels.title: Logs into VLSingle
panels.description: Lines per second read from container logs by vlagent and stored by VLSingle (left; Kubernetes events add to the stored lines), and the volume (right).

panels.title: Spans into VTSingle
panels.description: Spans per second over OTLP (left) next to the shop's request rate (right): the two move together; spans at 0 with traffic means the exporters cannot deliver.

panels.title: Delivery backlog
panels.description: Data the agents hold because the store does not take it fast enough or is down. It drains after a store restart; growing for long means the store is overloaded or unreachable. Beyond the on-disk queue size the oldest data is dropped.

panels.title: Delivery retries and errors
panels.description: Failed sends per second towards the stores. Retried from the agents' queues; persistent retries fire TooManyRemoteWriteErrors (vmagent, vlagent) or RemoteWriteErrors (vmalert).

panels.title: Dropped per 5 minutes
panels.description: Every place data is thrown away, by cause: rejected by a store (bad timestamps, too many fields, series limits), lines longer than the insert limit, blocks an agent gave up on, and bytes lost when an agent's disk queue was full.

targets.expr: label_replace(round(sum by (job) (increase(vm_persistentqueue_bytes_dropped_total[$__interval]))), "cause", "Agent disk queue full, bytes lost ($1)", "job", "(.*)") > 0

panels.title: Dropped in the time range
panels.description: Totals per cause in the time range (the queue cause counts bytes).

targets.expr: sum by (cause) (label_replace(round(sum by (reason) (increase(vm_rows_ignored_total{job="vmsingle-vmks"}[$__range]))), "cause", "Metrics rejected by VMSingle: $1", "reason", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum(increase({__name__=~"vm(agent)?_(hourly|daily)_series_limit_rows_dropped_total"}[$__range]))), "cause", "Metrics over the series limit", "", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum(increase(vmagent_remotewrite_samples_dropped_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Metric samples dropped by vmagent", "", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum(increase(vmagent_remotewrite_packets_dropped_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Metric blocks rejected by VMSingle", "", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum by (job) (increase(vl_too_long_lines_skipped_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Log lines too long ($1)", "job", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum by (reason) (increase(vl_rows_dropped_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Log lines rejected: $1", "reason", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum(increase(vlagent_remotewrite_packets_dropped_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Log blocks rejected by VLSingle", "", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum by (reason) (increase(vt_rows_dropped_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Spans rejected: $1", "reason", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum(increase(vmalert_remotewrite_dropped_rows_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Recording rule results dropped by vmalert", "", "(.*)") or label_replace(round(sum by (job) (increase(vm_persistentqueue_bytes_dropped_total[$__range]))), "cause", "Agent disk queue full, bytes lost ($1)", "job", "(.*)")) > 0

panels.title: Stores
panels.description: Configured retention against the oldest data actually kept, the disk, and how long until each store hits its limit at the growth of the last day. VMSingle turns read-only below 2 GB free (DiskRunsOutOfSpaceIn3Days warns). VLSingle and VTSingle then drop their oldest days instead: the oldest data shrinks below the retention (RetentionCutByDiskCap alerts) and growing the disk (storage in vm-k8s-stack.yaml) brings it back.

targets.expr: max by (store, value) (label_replace(max by (value) (flag{job="vmsingle-vmks", name="retentionPeriod"}), "store", "VictoriaMetrics", "", "") or label_replace(max by (value) (flag{job="vlsingle-vmks", name="retentionPeriod"}), "store", "VictoriaLogs", "", "") or label_replace(max by (value) (flag{job="vtsingle-vmks", name="retentionPeriod"}), "store", "VictoriaTraces", "", ""))

max by (store) (label_replace(max(kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{persistentvolumeclaim="vmsingle-vmks", namespace="monitoring"}), "store", "VictoriaMetrics", "", "") or label_replace(max(kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{persistentvolumeclaim="vlsingle-vmks", namespace="monitoring"}), "store", "VictoriaLogs", "", "") or label_replace(max(kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{persistentvolumeclaim="vtsingle-vmks", namespace="monitoring"}), "store", "VictoriaTraces", "", ""))

max by (store) (label_replace(max(1 - kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{persistentvolumeclaim="vmsingle-vmks", namespace="monitoring"} / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{persistentvolumeclaim="vmsingle-vmks", namespace="monitoring"}), "store", "VictoriaMetrics", "", "") or label_replace(max(1 - kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{persistentvolumeclaim="vlsingle-vmks", namespace="monitoring"} / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{persistentvolumeclaim="vlsingle-vmks", namespace="monitoring"}), "store", "VictoriaLogs", "", "") or label_replace(max(1 - kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{persistentvolumeclaim="vtsingle-vmks", namespace="monitoring"} / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{persistentvolumeclaim="vtsingle-vmks", namespace="monitoring"}), "store", "VictoriaTraces", "", ""))

max by (store, limit) (label_replace(label_replace(max(vm_free_disk_space_bytes{job="vmsingle-vmks"}) - max(vm_free_disk_space_limit_bytes{job="vmsingle-vmks"}), "limit", "read-only below 2 GB free", "", ""), "store", "VictoriaMetrics", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max(vl_max_disk_space_usage_bytes{job="vlsingle-vmks"}) - (max(vl_total_disk_space_bytes{job="vlsingle-vmks"}) - max(vl_free_disk_space_bytes{job="vlsingle-vmks"})), "limit", "oldest days dropped at 80%", "", ""), "store", "VictoriaLogs", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max(vt_max_disk_space_usage_bytes{job="vtsingle-vmks"}) - (max(vt_total_disk_space_bytes{job="vtsingle-vmks"}) - max(vt_free_disk_space_bytes{job="vtsingle-vmks"})), "limit", "oldest days dropped at 80%", "", ""), "store", "VictoriaTraces", "", ""))

panels.title: Room before the limit
panels.description: Free space left before each store's limit; a steady fall shows the growth.

panels.title: Volumes in monitoring
panels.description: Every persistent volume of the stack: the three stores, the agents' disk queues, Alertmanager and Grafana. VLSingle and VTSingle stay around 80% once full (by design).

panels.title: Watchdog
panels.description: The always-firing Watchdog alert: firing means vmalert evaluates rules and writes their state. Not firing means the alerting pipeline itself is down.

panels.title: Alertmanager peers
panels.description: Members of the Alertmanager gossip cluster (2 replicas). With 1, notifications still go out but are not deduplicated across replicas.

panels.title: Rule errors and missed evaluations
panels.description: Rule groups whose evaluation failed (query error, datasource down) or ran late (an evaluation took longer than the interval).

panels.title: Notifications
panels.description: Notifications Alertmanager sent and failed per integration, and alerts vmalert could not deliver to Alertmanager.

panels.title: DNS requests
panels.description: Queries kube-dns answers. NXDOMAIN is mostly normal: with ndots 5 every external name is first tried with the cluster search domains. Other errors (server failures) mean resolution breaks; a failing name such as an exporter endpoint shows up as "no such host" in the logs.

panels.title: DNS latency
panels.description: Time kube-dns takes to answer.

panels.title: kube-dns health probes
panels.description: The kube-dns sidecar probes its own kubedns and dnsmasq containers: latency (left) and failed probes (right).

panels.title: Restarts in the time range
panels.description: Containers of the stack that restarted (OOMKilled: memory limit; Error: crash or failed liveness probe). A store restart pauses ingestion and queries for its duration.

targets.expr: max by (pod, container, reason) (max_over_time(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="monitoring"}[$__range])) * on (pod, container) group_left () (sum by (pod, container) (round(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="monitoring"}[$__range]))) > 0) or on (pod, container) (sum by (pod, container) (round(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="monitoring"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: Memory against the limit, top 12 pods
panels.description: Working set memory of the stack's pods against their limit; at 100% the container is OOM-killed.

targets.expr: topk(12, sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="monitoring", container!=""}) / sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="monitoring", resource="memory"}))
